description: This PHP source file is a seed data script for creating quote entries within a SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM extension) environment. It loads predefined quote seed data, creates quote records, associated product bundles, and products, establishing relationships among them. The script also populates address information from accounts and handles related comments and metadata.

classes.name: Quote
classes.description: Represents a quote entity with related properties such as ID, name, description, stage, addresses, total amounts, team information, and associated methods.

classes.name: ProductBundle
classes.description: Represents a product bundle with properties like team info, stage, name, financial totals, and methods to manage relationships with products, notes, and quotes.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product included in a quote or bundle with attributes such as name, ID, quantity, prices, status, and relationships.

classes.name: ProductBundleNote
classes.description: Represents notes linked to product bundles, holding descriptions and relationships.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current object to the database, creating or updating the record.

methods.name: set_productbundle_product_relationship
methods.description: Establishes a relationship between a product bundle and a product.

methods.name: set_product_bundle_note_relationship
methods.description: Links a note to a product bundle.

methods.name: set_productbundle_quote_relationship
methods.description: Links a product bundle to a quote.
